## About
Rachel Danley founded her own local, family-owned contracting and restoration company in San Antonio, Rachel's Restoration LLC (dba Danley Restoration). Before that, she worked with a well-established local roofing company, helping homeowners through their roof replacements and learning the homeowners' insurance side of the job.
Our focus is roofing, with turn-key service: roof evaluation, a thorough inspection of the property and an insurance claim assessment, then design and selection for the improvements and coordination of all crews and work needed until completion. We also take on siding, painting, windows and doors, attic insulation and home renovations.
Rachel brings the same dedication and diligence to her customers that she brings to endurance sports. Our neighbors have rated us 4.9 from 20 Google reviews.

## Services
- Hail Damage: Roofing and hail damage restoration for homes around San Antonio.
- Roof Repair: Repairs for homes and businesses across greater San Antonio.
- Residential Roofing: Roof evaluation, inspection and replacement for homeowners.
- Commercial Roofing: Roofing work for commercial properties.
- Tile Roofing: Tile roof installation and repair.
- Metal Roofing: Metal roofs, including standing seam. One customer had the old roofing removed and a new standing seam metal roof installed.
- Attic Insulation: Blown-in attic insulation.
- Energy Efficient Windows: Energy-efficient door and window installation.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with my homeowners' insurance claim?
A: Yes. Insurance claim assessment is part of how we start every job, and we supplement homeowners' insurance claims so you receive the funds needed to complete the repairs.

Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us for a free roofing estimate.

Q: Do you do more than roofs?
A: We do. Along with roofing, we handle general contracting, siding, painting, energy-efficient doors and windows, attic insulation and home renovations.

Q: Where are you located?
A: Our office is at 1401 Universal City Blvd. in Universal City, TX 78148, and we serve San Antonio and the surrounding area.
